newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Brunel IPO to close earlier for private investors.
newsitem.headline: Brunel IPO to close earlier for private investors.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in Dutch specialist temporary employment firm Brunel International will be closed for private investors on Monday, June 16 at 0900 GMT, Brunel and ABN AMRO Rothschild said on Friday.

The issue would be closed earlier than originally planned to ease the subscription procedure, they said in a joint press release. Subscriptions opened on June 12 and were first planned to close on June 24.
Earlier this week, ABN AMRO and Brunel said the shares were to be priced at 36 to 41 guilders per share.
A maximum of 7.8 million shares or 40 percent of Brunel's share capital will be offered to investors.
Brunel specialises in supplying highly trained temporary staff in information technology and engineering disciplines.
